Composite two images: place the woman from the first image into the treadmill of the second image, running on it.

SUBJECT (from the woman image): A young woman with long dark wavy hair, with the SAME face and SAME body proportions as the reference. Athletic curvy body with very large round voluminous buttocks, wide hips, slim waist. She must wear the EXACT same outfit as in her reference image: a light beige cream-colored crop top (sleeveless, form-fitting) and tight black high-waisted leggings. Do not change her clothing. She is now RUNNING on the treadmill — dynamic mid-run pose: one leg forward in mid-stride, the other leg back pushing off, knees lifted high, hips in athletic running motion, torso leaning slightly forward, both arms bent at the elbows pumping naturally with the running rhythm. Her body should show the energy and motion of a real person running hard. Hair bouncing dynamically in motion. Expression focused and determined. Sweat glistening on her skin.

PRESERVATION (from the gym image): Keep the gym background EXACTLY as it is — the treadmill she runs on, the rubber floor, the other equipment, the walls, the lighting and color grading. Do not alter the gym architecture, equipment, or environment. Do not add or remove background objects.

INTEGRATION: Match the woman's lighting to the gym — the same cold fluorescent LED lighting, cool tones, harsh shadows consistent with gym lighting. Cast a natural dynamic contact shadow on the treadmill belt beneath her feet and on the rubber floor behind her. Add realistic motion blur on her arms and legs to convey the speed of running. Her skin should show realistic gym sweat and effort. Her scale and perspective must match the treadmill's geometry — she must look like she is actually standing on the running belt.

STYLE: Photorealistic, shot on iPhone 17 Pro, casual smartphone photography, natural colors, sharp focus on the woman's face and body with slight motion blur on extremities. Seamless, undetectable composite — the woman must look like a real person genuinely running on this treadmill in this gym, as if she was originally photographed there.

You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.
